title: $900 PS5 Pro Sold Out in US Amid GTA 6 Fever
description: Sony's $900 PS5 Pro is selling out in the US driven by GTA 6 fever, with third-party sellers charging up to $1300 despite ongoing hardware boycotts.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## $900 PS5 Pro Sold Out in US Amid GTA 6 Fever

When it comes to system-moving powerhouses in the video game industry, few titles carry the sheer gravitational pull of *Grand Theft Auto VI*. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, Sony's supercharged PS5 Pro hardware model is currently selling out across the United States as a wave of "GTA 6 fever" takes complete hold of the gaming community.

### High Demand Defies Controversy and Protests

The rush to secure Sony's most powerful console model comes despite an ongoing blackout protest taking place against PlayStation hardware. Frustrated fans have mobilized across various online spaces to keep their current consoles unplugged indefinitely in protest. Yet, such is the overwhelming demand for the ultimate *GTA 6* gaming experience that these community pushbacks have done little to cool down the market.

With a hefty official manufacturer's suggested retail price (MSRP) of $900, the PS5 Pro was always going to target the most dedicated enthusiasts. However, the desperate race to own the hardware has allowed third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon to capitalize heavily on the frenzy, pushing prices as high as $1,300 for a single device—representing a massive mark-up over its standard retail cost.

### The Ultimate Preparation for an Open-World Giant

The debate of "no disc drive, no buy?" has clearly taken a back seat for thousands of consumers who prioritize raw performance above all else as they prepare for Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece. As anticipation for *GTA 6* reaches unprecedented heights, high-end hardware availability is becoming a major battleground for players wanting to experience the game in its highest fidelity.

## Editor's Take

The fact that a $900 console is selling out and being scalped for $1,300 amidst hardware boycotts speaks volumes about the unstoppable momentum of *GTA 6*. Gamers are voting with their wallets, proving that performance and visual fidelity will always trump controversy when the biggest game of a generation is on the horizon.
